correctness.rationale: Independent chord construction from 2n uniform points induces uniform rank matching. For chord (a,b), conditional pair probabilities qC=2ℓ(1−ℓ), qN=ℓ²+2a(1−b); direct independent SymPy integrals against density 2 give means 1/3, variances 1/45 and Cov(qC,qN)=0 exactly. Pair indicators on the same two chords cannot both occur, hence covariance −1/9; distinct overlapping pair mixed covariances vanish by projected orthogonality. Counting n(n−1)(n−2) overlapping ordered pair incidences yields Var n(n−1)(n+3)/45, Cov −n(n−1)/18. The Hoeffding order-two first projections scale n^(3/2) and have diagonal covariance; degenerate residual var O(n²), so the bivariate CLT yields independent Gaussian coordinates. n=2 nondegenerate covariance formulas hold; no finite experiment is offered as CLT proof.
